item.title: SWG Legends 10th Anniversary Event Begins With Riddles, Prizes and Celebration
item.description: SWG Legends is celebrating its 10th anniversary with daily riddles, community events, and giveaways. Heres everything happening leading up to the big celebration.

item.title: Villion: Code opening movie; party cooperation details
item.description: Compile Heart has released the opening movie and four soundtrack song videos for Villion: Code, the upcoming school RPG led by Megami Tensei and Persona series co-creator Kouji Okada.

item.title: Metroidvania Inspired by Item Randomizer Mods 'Randomice' is Now Available on PC
item.description: Randomice is a cozy Metroidvania where items are randomized, and no two play throughs are ever the same. The title quietly released on Steam in November of 2025, but is now back with a new February update.

item.title: Narrative-Driven JRPG x Fighter 'A Fighters Nova: Mindara' Announced for PC
item.description: Announcing A Fighter's Nova: Mindara, a new narrative-driven JRPG that mixes storytelling and exploration with the intensity of a fighting game.

item.title: Silent Planet Announced for PlayStation 5 and Xbox
item.description: Vertex Zero has announced Silent Planet will be coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S along with the previously announced PC release.

item.title: PS6 Will Not Be A Digital Only Console, Says Former PlayStation Boss
item.description: Sony Interactive Entertainment's next console, the PS6, will not be digital only, according to former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden.

item.title: Nioh 3 sales top one million
item.description: Total sales for Nioh 3 have surpassed one million units worldwide, publisher Koei Tecmo and developer Team NINJA announced. It reached the one million mark faster than any previous Nioh game.

item.title: Star Wars Galactic Racer PC System Requirements Revealed Can Your PC Run It?
item.description: The PC system requirements for Star Wars Galactic Racer are officially revealed. Check minimum and recommended specs to see if your PC can run the new Star Wars racing game.

item.title: Armatus Preview | The Outerhaven
item.description: Armatus is the currently in development Roguelike 3rd person shooter from Counterplay Games, that feels like a cross between Returnal and Hades, with some enjoyable gunplay and a fun gameplay loop.

item.title: Announcing 'Directory Dungeon' a Unique Dungeon Crawler Played in Windows File Explorer
item.description: Developer JuhrJuhr has announced their unique dungeon crawler, Directory Dungeon, which is played within Windows File Explorer.
